tools.name: Bundled stdlib evaluator
tools.capability: Run deterministic RAG/LLM fixture checks and red-green mutation without credentials
limits: Does not call a live model

tools.name: Promptfoo
tools.capability: Evaluate and red-team prompts, models, RAG and agents through declarative configs and CI
tools.setup: Node/npm or npx; provider credentials for live models

tools.name: DeepEval
tools.capability: Pytest-like LLM, RAG and agent evaluation with built-in and custom metrics
tools.setup: Python package and optional judge model credentials
limits: Many semantic metrics rely on a judge model

tools.name: Playwright Test Agents
tools.capability: Planner, generator and healer workflows for Playwright tests
tools.setup: Playwright project and supported coding agent
limits: Generated or healed tests still require oracle review
